Question: Why do I get a heavy heart thinking and talking about my twin flame?
Answer: It might be because you are in separation or just friends while you want to be lovers. You are focused on 3D reality instead of raising your vibration to higher densities, where you and your TF are in a spiritual union. Meditation or spiritual practice can help with that. It is also possible that you are highly empathetic with the TF and they are going through illness or depression and you are picking up their physical state or emotions. Connecting with the Source, Guides, Angels, or Higher Self and sending them healing energy instead of sharing their depressed state might be a remedy for this situation.

Name: Irina Nola
Question: I can't go on with my twin flame journey. It's getting me into trouble. It feels like I am stalking her. How do I hold back or stop?
Answer: You might consider getting some sessions with a traditional psychotherapist who has experience with romantic obsessions. If you are stalking your TF - this is a mental health issue you need professional help with. Unfortunately, obsessions are hard to control with rational thought and will, so you might need somebody with experience in this field to help you, and you might also need some medication if you have an underlining psychiatric condition. Most TFs who do not have any mental health problems can control their chasing and stop emailing, texting, calling, waiting to meet the TF in their favorite places or near home or work. They still think about them or see dreams with them, but it does not cross the border of “stalking”. All advice about putting energy on yourself, surrender, letting go and letting God you can still use, but in your case, I think you might need professional help… A drastic measure would be moving away - if your TF and you live in the same city. And deleting their email, number, blocking their social media accounts. Going backpacking around the world for a year. Getting a job abroad - there are plenty of those from farming to teaching English. Becoming an apprentice in a Catholic or Buddhist monastery. Joining Hari Krishna. Joining any church with many youth programs requiring a lot of volunteering and being present at services, keeping you busy and your mind occupied. Enrolling into a course of study - again to keep you busy and your mind away from the object of obsession. However, I still think you might need a clinical evaluation and psychotherapy, and possibly some pharmacological medication…

Question: What if you had a dream about being stuck between a snow bank and a car and you can't get out?
Answer: The car symbolizes your resources and goals on the road of life, ability to move freely, and the snow - frozen emotions. You had a trauma that you did not heal, and only numbed yourself without processing the pain, and now you feel stuck as “encapsulated trauma’ can block the energy flow in your subtle bodies and prevent you from moving ahead in life. It might be a ‘smiling depression” when you act normally, and unaware of depression, but you lose all motivation or interest in life. Get some therapy or Inner Child healing.
